audit.whatIsWrong: The entry says Sion breaks his own shield with E — 'his E shield-break out-ranges your comfortable trade', 'walk up under W's shield and break it with E for a chunk', 'Save W to destroy his E poke'. It also never names a single Sion ability.
audit.why: Soul Furnace is self-contained: 'Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby.' The detonation is the W re-cast, not E. E is Roar of the Slayer, a separate 800-range shockwave that slows and shreds armour. Getting this wrong means the reader watches the wrong ability for the burst and mistimes the only window in the lane — the three seconds between the shield going up and the detonation coming out.
audit.corrected: Soul Furnace shields, then re-casts after 3s for the damage. Roar of the Slayer is the 800-range poke. Name Glory in Death, Decimating Smash, Soul Furnace, Roar of the Slayer and Unstoppable Onslaught.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the entry tells Mel what Rebuttal is actually for in this lane; it is only ever mentioned as a shield against his E poke.
audit.why: Roar of the Slayer is the one projectile in Sion's kit, and it is his only ranged tool at 800 units. Rebuttal reflects projectiles, so his poke pattern is the thing the barrier was built for. Second, that same spell knocks a minion backwards through everyone the minion passes through — so standing behind your own wave does not shelter you from it, it gives him a second body to throw.
audit.corrected: Spend Rebuttal on Roar of the Slayer, and do not treat your own wave as cover against it.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Save W to destroy his E poke and hold your root for his knockup' gives no numbers and no ordering.
audit.why: Soul Furnace is 15/14/13/12/11s and its detonation lands three seconds after the shield appears. Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6s and only knocks up if he charges it long enough — a quick release is flat damage. Roar of the Slayer is 12/11/10/9/8s. So there is a real, countable window: the moment the Soul Furnace detonation goes off, he has roughly fifteen seconds at rank 1 with no shield between Mel's stacks and his health bar, and that is when the execute maths is worth attempting.
audit.corrected: State the 3s delay on the Soul Furnace re-cast and the 15s that follow it, and that only a long Decimating Smash charge knocks up.

audit.why: The entry is honest that Mel loses the scaling race and that her execute threshold does not trip against a health-and-MR stacked Sion. That matches the 18.18% figure and matches the kit — Overwhelm scales on stored damage, not on percent health, so his HP bar is the direct counter to it. No change.

edits.after: A charged Decimating Smash is the threat: it connects, Soul Furnace detonates on top of you, and you have no dash out of the follow-up.

edits.after: Golden Eclipse should execute — but his health pool plus Glory in Death mean the detonation rarely closes the kill and he reanimates to keep swinging at you.

edits.after: Reflect Roar of the Slayer with Rebuttal — that 800-range poke is the only projectile in his kit

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash — you have one ability and your ranged auto, he just walks up and last-hits behind his W shield. Your one real window is Level 2: get Q and E first, and the moment he steps up for a cannon, land Solar Snare's root and unload Q bolts while he's stuck. After that it gets ugly. His W shield soaks your Q poke, his E shield-break out-ranges your comfortable trade, and his charged Q knockup is a death sentence — you have zero dashes, so if that lands he gets a full combo and you can't leave. Stay at max range, never facecheck for the cannon, and respect a fully-charged Q from fog.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — you have one ability and your ranged auto, he just walks up and last-hits behind Soul Furnace. Your one real window is Level 2: get Q and E first, and the moment he steps up for a cannon, land Solar Snare's root and unload Q bolts while he's stuck. After that it gets ugly. Soul Furnace soaks your Q poke, Roar of the Slayer reaches 800 against your 950, and a charged Decimating Smash is a death sentence — zero dashes means one landed knockup is a full combo. Stay at max range, never facecheck for the cannon, and respect a charged Q from fog.

edits.before: This is where the lane slips away. On paper your kit eats immobile juggernauts, but Sion isn't trying to all-in you — he buys armor, stacks health, and shoves the wave into your tower so you can't punish. Your Overwhelm execute needs the stored damage to exceed his health-plus-shields, and his W shield plus a growing HP bar means that threshold almost never trips. At 6 your Golden Eclipse should be a kill, but his zombie passive means even a good detonation just sends him into undead state to keep swinging or take your tower. Save W to destroy his E poke and hold your root for his knockup, not for offense.

At 6 your Golden Eclipse should be a kill, but Glory in Death means even a good detonation just reanimates him to keep swinging or take your tower. Spend Rebuttal reflecting Roar of the Slayer, which also knocks a minion back through everyone behind it.

notes: The packet's suspectName 'Solar Snare's' is a false positive — Mel's real E name with a possessive. TWO THINGS NEED A MANUAL PASS HERE. (1) The full layer rates this FAVOURED, difficulty 4/10, Sion carry threat 5/10, with six of seven phases marked Mel, against an 18.18% win rate over 11 games and a content chart that correctly gives Sion four stages. diff, diffRating, carryRating and phases[].side are all shorter than the applier's 12-character minimum for full-layer edits, so I could not propose corrections; breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t carry the same wrong sentence but are byte-identical to each other, so the applier would reject them as ambiguous. (2) _missing-interactions.json claims 'Sion can cut your retreat with Unstoppable Onslaught (R)' from a terrain flag — Riot's text describes a steerable charge that knocks up on collision, with no terrain creation, so I did not write that anywhere. The same file's 'resistances-invalidated' entry for Soul Furnace also looks like a flag artefact: the percentHealth flag on that ability is the max-health he gains on kills, not percent-health damage dealt.
